title: BandGap: Evaluation of machine-learned band gaps — two-stage modeling and the effects of data representation and split strategy (code and stored results)
description: Analysis code, SLURM job scripts, environment files and stored result files for the manuscript "Evaluation of Machine-Learned Band Gaps: Two-Stage Modeling and the Effects of Data Representation and Split Strategy" (Solecki & Zhu, Computational Materials Science, manuscript COMMAT-D-26-02664). Includes the two-stage classify-then-regress XGBoost pipeline, nested and grouped cross-validation, feature ablation and SHAP analyses, the tabular regressor comparison, CGCNN / MEGNet-style / ALIGNN-style graph networks with five-seed runs, cross-dataset transfer with bias correction, pooled multi-fidelity training, and a command-line diagnostic utility. Datasets are obtained via matminer (scripts/fetch_data.py) and the Materials Data Facility.
